summary: Completed testing of Consulting Efforts Summary page. All features working correctly. Backend APIs (efforts-summary, meeting attendance) return proper data. Frontend displays all stats cards, expandable sections, filters, and action buttons correctly.

minor.issue: Consultant shows 'Unknown' because meetings created by admin lack created_by_name field - this is expected behavior per main agent notes

issues: HTML warning: <tr> cannot be child of <span> in console - React development warning, does not affect functionality
Chart width/height warnings appear initially but charts render correctly after data loads

stats_cards.details: All 6 stats cards display: Total Meetings (23), With Attendance (0 - governance rule), With MOM (10), Total Hours (24.2), Tasks Completed (0/0), Timely Delivery (0%)

expenses_summary.details: Shows Total, Approved, Pending expense amounts

payments_summary.details: Shows Invoiced, Received, Overdue amounts and Collection rate

meetings_by_consultant.details: Expandable section with bar chart and table showing consultant breakdown

meetings_by_project.details: Expandable section showing 6 projects with Committed/Delivered/Extra counts

meetings_by_company.details: Expandable section showing 5 companies with Total Meetings, Delivered, Client Approved, Approval Rate

payment_collection.details: Expandable section with pie chart showing payment collection status

print_report_button.details: Print Report button visible and triggers window.print()

refresh_button.details: Refresh button visible and refetches data when clicked

filters.details: All filters present: Projects dropdown (6 projects), Consultants dropdown, Companies dropdown, Date range (From/To)

efforts_summary_api.details: Returns all required fields: summary, duration, tasks, by_consultant, by_project, by_client, expenses, payments

critical_code_review_comments: HTML structure warning: The map() inside tbody creates a span wrapper around tr elements. This is a common React pattern issue but doesn't break functionality.
Charts show width/height warnings on initial load but render correctly after data arrives
seed_data: Used existing 23 consulting meetings from database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Consulting Efforts Summary page fully functional. All stats cards, expandable sections, filters work correctly. Backend API at /api/stats/consulting/efforts-summary returns comprehensive data. Meeting attendance API at /api/attendance/meeting/{id} working.
